Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL4649949. Join assays, activities, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter for exact measurements where standard_value is not null and standard_relation equals '='. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
